exposure: Cesarean section with transverse uterine fundal incision (TUFI)
outcome: Safety for mother and neonate (initial procedure)
Conditions for approving a post-TUFI pregnancy
cohort: The study cohort consists of patients who underwent Cesarean section with transverse uterine fundal incision (TUFI) and subsequently desired to conceive again.
finding: Based on 17 years of experience, subsequent pregnancies after TUFI are deemed safe, provided specific conditions related to suture method, conception delay (at least 12 months), scar evaluation, and cautious postoperative management are met.
mod_finding: The study provides recommendations for the approval and management of subsequent pregnancies following a specific mode of birth (transverse uterine fundal incision cesarean section), primarily addressing the risk of uterine rupture.
